summary: Product designer with 8 years shipping data-heavy B2B products end to end — discovery, interaction design, and the design system work that keeps it all consistent. I like problems where the interface has to make something genuinely complicated feel obvious, and I measure my work by what changes after it ships.

experience.description: Analytics platform for logistics teams, ~40k weekly active users.

bullets.text: Redesigned the shipment tracking dashboard around a single timeline view, cutting the median time to answer "where is my order" from 90 seconds to 12.
Built and documented a 60-component design system with two engineers; new feature work now ships without bespoke UI in roughly 80% of cases.
Ran a 14-interview discovery study with warehouse operators that killed a planned feature and redirected the quarter toward bulk editing, which became the most-used release of the year.
Mentored two junior designers through their first end-to-end features, both now shipping independently.

experience.description: Subscription commerce startup, seed to Series B.

bullets.text: Owned checkout end to end across web and mobile web; reduced cart abandonment by 18% over two quarters through progressive disclosure and clearer shipping costs.
Introduced weekly usability testing on a shoestring — five sessions, every Thursday — which caught three launch-blocking issues in the first month.
Partnered with the growth team on 20+ A/B tests, designing variants that stayed inside the brand system instead of one-off landing pages.
Designed marketing sites and product interfaces for eight client engagements, from first wireframe through developer handoff.
Standardised the studio's handoff process around annotated component specs, which cut back-and-forth with client engineers noticeably on every project after it.

education.note: Thesis on decision-making interfaces for time-critical work.

projects.name: Fieldnotes
projects.tagline: Offline-first note app for site inspectors
projects.description: Side project, ~2k users. Designed and shipped the whole thing, including the sync-conflict flow that turned out to be the hardest screen I have ever drawn. Also wrote the CSS, which is why the animations are restrained.

projects.name: Density
projects.tagline: Figma plugin that audits spacing against your token scale
projects.description: Open-source, ~4k installs. Scans a file for off-scale spacing values and offers one-click fixes. Built it after losing an afternoon to a 13px gap nobody could find.

projects.name: Interface Teardowns
projects.tagline: Weekly written analysis of one B2B interface
projects.description: 120 issues, ~1,800 subscribers. Writing one teardown a week did more for my critique vocabulary than any course, and two of the essays became internal reading at Northwind.

projects.name: Atlas (community project)
projects.tagline: Volunteer redesign of a food-bank scheduling tool
projects.description: Rebuilt the volunteer shift signup with two engineers, pro bono. Cut the signup flow from nine screens to three; no-show rate dropped by roughly a third over the following season.
